The jet stream over the Pacific is blowing 224 miles per hour right now, faster than a Category 5 hurricane. And it's pointed at the West Coast: it'll keep sending storm after storm into the Pacific Northwest and California all next week, with rounds of rain and mountain snow. https://t.co/wlxFYE7qJe
Kentucky is going to freeze before Chicago does. Lexington drops to about 31 tonight, while Chicago stays near 38 and still hasn't hit freezing once this fall. https://t.co/6BwXP4F7ff
The nicest weather in the USA today will be in and around Rio Rancho, NM, Dodge City, KS, and Asheville, NC. https://t.co/GOpUHvkWgc
Norfolk is having its wettest November day on record. The airport has picked up 5.5 inches of rain so far today, beating the old record of 5.02 inches from 1893. https://t.co/Jrj9xIUl7E
Minneapolis finally froze early this morning. It hit 31, tied for the third latest first freeze there since 1872.

The first freeze is FINALLY here tonight for Cincinnati and Indianapolis, 18 days later than normal...

Freeze Warnings currently stretch from Missouri to West Virginia. https://t.co/vvFsxA1mba

Norfolk just had its 8th wettest day EVER... 6.31 inches of rain on Friday, in records going back to 1871.

What’s crazy is every day wetter than that came between July and October, mostly from hurricanes like Ernesto, Irene and Matthew! https://t.co/tckiA28dQL

Google is saying I am married…

Norfolk just had its wettest November day EVER with at least 5.56 inches haven fallen by 5pm ET...

That breaks a record from 1893, with weather records going back all the way to 1874. https://t.co/oL0ZQzlEpQ

For the first time in 44 YEARS, a tropical storm has formed in the Central Pacific in November...

Pena becomes the 26th tropical storm to form in this year's record-breaking Pacific hurricane season, and it is expected to remain well south of Hawaii over the next several days. https://t.co/N3o8DHSnEP
